hooks.command: osascript -e 'display notification "Claude Code is waiting for you." with title "Claude Code"'
osascript -e 'display notification "Claude Code completed tasks." with title "Claude Code"'

if [ -n "${HOME-}" ] && [ -f "${HOME-}/.orca/agent-hooks/claude-hook.sh" ] && [ -r "${HOME-}/.orca/agent-hooks/claude-hook.sh" ] && [ -x "${HOME-}/.orca/agent-hooks/claude-hook.sh" ]; then ORCA_HOOK_AGENT_PID="${PPID:-}"; export ORCA_HOOK_AGENT_PID; /bin/sh "${HOME-}/.orca/agent-hooks/claude-hook.sh"; else { command -p cat 2>/dev/null || cat; } >/dev/null 2>&1 || :; fi
